canonical.title: Weekend at Bad Ragaz, anchored on Memories

sources.title: Grand Resort Bad Ragaz — Inclusive services 2026
sources.claim: Memories serves Wed–Sat from 19:00, single seating; kitchen closes ~21:30; inclusive thermal + transfer package attaches only to direct rates

sources.title: Memories — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Memories at Grand Resort Bad Ragaz, three-star Michelin under Sven Wassmer; pairing menus push the meal past 22:30

sources.title: Sorell Hotel Tamina — TripAdvisor
sources.claim: Sorell Tamina (4★) ~3 minutes' walk from Memories; cluster of self-check-in 3★ rooms in Bad Ragaz village

sources.title: Park Hotel Sonnenhof — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Park Hotel Sonnenhof in Vaduz, ~13 min taxi from Memories, Relais & Châteaux property with Marée 1-Michelin restaurant

sources.title: Panoramarestaurant Marée — Alpen Erleben
sources.claim: Panoramarestaurant Marée at Sonnenhof — 1-Michelin star, panoramic Rhine valley view

sources.title: Hotel Weiss Kreuz — Gault Millau
sources.claim: Hotel Weiss Kreuz in Malans, four guest rooms above a 1-Michelin / 17-pt Gault Millau restaurant

sources.title: Schlaf-Fass Maienfeld
sources.claim: Converted 8,000-litre oak wine barrel sleeping cabin above the village of Maienfeld, near Heidi's house

sources.title: Weingut Donatsch
